notes.notes:

notes.title: Patch Nov. 22
notes.notes: Procedural buildings not working, so we rolled back and created a new branch with the procedural on it.

notes.title: Patch Dec. 22
notes.notes: Solved procedural buildings not working properly

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov. 22
notes.notes:
New features : 

 Added a second gamemode : Capture The Objective, where you will have to find a Briefcase on the map, and bring it back to the Supply Crate without dying.
 Added the procedural system to generate our game map, in order for the building to always be different in every game you will play.
